ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Uninstall of Windows Defender Feature via PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of PowerShell with Uninstall-WindowsFeature or Remove-WindowsFeature cmdlets to disable or remove the Windows Defender GUI feature, a common technique used by adversaries to evade defenses.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\_ISE\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Uninstall\\-WindowsFeature.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Remove\\-WindowsFeature.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Windows\\-Defender.*"))
